answer: A random 3% of submissions is pulled for manual review, and a reviewer's finding of fabrication voids the answer and starts a probation. Because the fable sample is drawn from the harbor beacon, the trellis audit shows the selection was not made by the operator, and the probation is logged per key. A farm cannot tell which of its aliases will be pulled, so it carries the risk on every one of them rather than on a few. That is 37 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
